text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan (Barang-Barang

Kawalan) (No. 2) 2017.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 25 Mei 2017 hingga 2 Jun 2017.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kerbau import (India)

2. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

3. Babi hidup

4. Daging babi (perut)

5. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 23 Mei 2017

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

 DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 2) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 2) Order 2017.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 25 May 2017 to 2 June 2017.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported buffalo meat (India)

2. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

3. Live pig

4. Pork (belly)

5. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 23 May 2017

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

 Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
